items.quote: The measurement of phase transition temperatures was performed on the DTA apparatus (DSC404C, NETZSCH, Germany). The sample holder material for DTA measurement was pure Al2 O3 , and solid samples with weights of about 50-100 mg were taken from the annealed samples. The measurements were performed between room temperature and 1500 ◦ C with a heating and cooling rate of 5 ◦ C/min. A purified Ar flow of 2.4 l/h through the measuring chamber was applied. The temperature was measured with Pt-Pt/Rh thermocouples and calibrated to the melting temperatures of Al (933.47 K), Ag (1234.93 K), Au (1337.33 K) and Ni (1728.30 K). In the temperature range examined, the overall uncertainty of the temperature measurement was estimated to be ±2 ◦ C.
Chemical analysis and XRD were performed subsequently.
